description: This file defines constants, structures, and function prototypes related to pack mtime management in a Git-like version control system. It includes definitions for reading and retrieving modification times (mtimes) from packed git objects.

methods.name: load_pack_mtimes
methods.description: Loads the .mtimes file associated with a packed_git object, returning zero on success.

methods.name: nth_packed_mtime
methods.description: Retrieves the mtime of the object at position 'pos' within the pack 'p'.
